section.sectionSummaryBrief: Yehudah's approach and speech to Yosef caused Yosef to reveal himself, explaining why he delayed doing so until then.
section.t: And this will be understood with an introduction to what Yehudah's approach to Yosef and his statement "How can I go up to my father etc."30
brought about that Yosef could not restrain himself etc. and made himself known to his brothers.31
For superficially, after they all came to him with Binyamin his brother, he should have made himself known to them immediately,
and why did he hide the goblet in Binyamin's sack32
in order that they should come to him yet again.
And also then he did not make himself known to them immediately,
and only after Yehudah approached him and argued his claims,
then specifically he made himself known to his brothers.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Binyamin represents the lower tzaddik who raises the recipient from below to above, and Yosef's concealment of the goblet was to elicit the raising of mayin nukvin from the recipient in a hidden manner.
section.t: And the point of the explanation of this33,
that Binyamin is the lower tzaddik who raises the recipient from below to above34
and connects him to the influencer.
And the main raising of mayin nukvin of Malchus is through Binyamin35.
And therefore the main raising of mayin nukvin of the tribes was when they came to Yosef the second time for the sake of Binyamin36.
And this that Yosef hid the goblet in Binyamin's sack,
it is,
because in order to arouse the raising of mayin nukvin of Malchus it is through the drawing down from Z'eir Anpin37
(as above in section 2).
And it can be said,
that this that Yosef commanded to hide the goblet in Binyamin's sack
(and Binyamin and the tribes did not know of this),
it is,
because in order that the raising of mayin nukvin of the recipient be from the side of the recipient,
it is when the drawing down from the influencer that arouses the recipient is in concealment38.
And this that after this the goblet was found,
it is,
because after the raising of mayin nukvin was already aroused within them,
the drawing down comes in revelation.
And through this they were elevated even more than their elevation when the goblet was hidden.
And this is that after the goblet was found, Yehudah said39
"God has found the iniquity of your servants,"
because after he was elevated to a more lofty level,
even the most subtle matter was considered to him as an iniquity40.
And then "Yehudah approached him,"
his raising of mayin nukvin
[and of all the tribes]
was in completeness.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: Yehudah explained to Yosef that by drawing down to Malchus, Yosef himself would be elevated from Chochmah to Kesser, like Paroh.
section.t: And behold, when Yehudah wanted to arouse Yosef that he should draw down to him a drawing of mayin duchrin,
he said to him1
"Please let your servant speak a word in my lord's ears etc., for you are like Paroh."
And the explanation of this41,
that because the drawing down from Z'eir Anpin to Malchus is a descent,
therefore Yehudah explained to Yosef that on the contrary,
through this there will be an ascent in Z'eir Anpin,
that he will be "like you, like Paroh."
For Yosef, as he is from his own side, begins from Chochmah which is the beginning of revelation,
and through his influencing "your servant,"
Malchus,
he will be "like Paroh,"
Kesser,
and in Kesser itself—the innerness of Kesser41.
